text:
maria-finance: Heads up — April batch invoice generation completed but support_fee line is missing for ~120 accounts and we have ~32 duplicate invoices (same external_id, different internal id). Seen in S3 preview. Anyone on call?

ashley-billing: Which run id? I can pull an example.

maria-finance: run: invoice-batch-20260401-03

billing-bot: invoice-batch-20260401-03 finished with warnings: missing_line_items=120 duplicate_invoice_attempts=32 (see /batches/20260401-03)

sam-engineering: pulling logs now. @ashley-billing can you paste one affected invoice id?

ashley-billing: INV-202604-54721

maria-finance: example invoice preview:
```
{
  "invoice_id": "INV-202604-54721",
  "customer": "acme-corp",
  "lines": [
    {"code":"compute","amount_cents":125000},
    {"code":"reserved_capacity","amount_cents":25000}
    // support_fee line missing
  ],
  "total_cents":150000
}
```

kevin-ops: looks like the support_fee join failed in post-process when refund_count > 0. quick grep shows a conditional like `if (usage.total > 0) computeSupport()` which skips when compute usage is 0 but we still need flat support fee.

sam-engineering: confirmed — bug introduced in commit 3f8c9a7 (pricing-refactor). Fixing conditional and adding unit test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/1427

ashley-billing: duplicates are from the retry path — if the initial run partially completes (writes invoice header but fails before line insert) the retry creates a new internal id instead of reusing the reserved external id.

tim-sre: we need idempotency on invoice creation. I'll add a short-term guard in the retry worker to check external_id existence before creating. Runbook: https://wiki.redwood.ai/runbooks/billing-duplicates

diana-cs: we already have 8 customers who reported mismatch, pinged them with an acknowledgment. Will need reissued credits/refunds for a few.

maria-finance: freezing outbound invoice emails for the April batch until we reconcile. :warning:

sam-engineering: deploying hotfix to staging now, will run a validation sweep, then prod if green. ETA ~20m.

sam-engineering: hotfix deployed to prod, validation sweep passed for a sample of 500 invoices. Monitoring metrics.

billing-bot: reconciliation job queued: recon-20260401-1 (assigned to ashley-billing). Will attempt to void true duplicates and reissue corrected invoices for affected accounts.

ashley-billing: I'll prioritize top 10 customers by ARR manually and then run automated reissue for the rest. Posting a checklist in #support. Assigning follow-ups.

maria-finance: thanks — please post final reconciliation summary when done.
